title: Verifier Claim Registry - v3
description: Consequence-specific exact-action claims layered on the universal v2 claim registry. This artifact defines claims; it does not declare implementation support in any verifier build.

claims.name: permit.delegate_child_linkage.v1
claims.assertion: The child created and granted authority is the privacy-safe child reference bound by the signed exact Delegate Permit, and, when acting-child evidence is present, the dispatched action Permit is bound to that same child and authority chain.
claims.required_evidence: Supported permit.decision.v1, permit.type.v1, and permit.material_request.v1 for keel.action.agent_delegate.v1; a signed keel.delegate_child_linkage.v1 artifact; matching Permit/project/request identities; equal intended, created, grant-delegate, and acting-child commitments; and a signed action-Permit binding digest plus authority-chain digest when acting-child linkage is claimed.
does_not_establish: independent real-world identity of the child behind the commitment
